scopeClassification: No schema change, no new dependency, no new external surface: the refine reuses the browser's existing read-only search client against prod_catalog, the same client the storefront grid already uses. Not security-sensitive; no new key.
goal: Restore the inline facet funnel on the simplified architecture: chips refine the shelf in place (no agent turn), chips derive from the index's own facet counts (no hardcoded list), and the shelf shows complete rows of four.

fixes.1_inline_funnel: Port buildFacetRefineParams + turn-constraint extraction from 5948289 into the grouped display. Chip tap = one client search (turn query + facet_<Attribute>/facet_filters constraints + selections ANDed + Inventory_InStock:true), shelf swaps, Back restores.
fixes.2_index_derived_chips: Delete the OFFERABLE whitelist in narrowChips.ts; derive attributes from the search's own facet counts, most-discriminative first, cap 3 axes x 3 values, one row per axis, price bands in price order (the accepted 2026-10-26 design).
fixes.3_deterministic_rows: Gate guarantees complete rows of four: fold small groups, trim each group to a multiple of 4 (logged), thin shelves under 4 pieces render as-is. Agent-side count contract ships later with the agent lane (fix 4), not this branch.
